envelope.description: Complete mode for the ripgrep search backend

body.title: Complete mode for the ripgrep search backend
body.summary: Add the optional complete flag to GrepSearchOptions in src/daemon/tools/builtins/search/grep.ts and implement it for the ripgrep backend: no hit limit, no per-line cut, no output cap, ripgrep output read as a stream and parsed in complete records, the files the backend excludes by rule stated in the result, and a fixed 30-second deadline after which the process is stopped and the call fails with the hits gathered attached and an incomplete status. Without the flag every other caller keeps MAX_LIMIT, MAX_LINE_CHARS and RG_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES exactly as today.
acceptanceChecks: With complete set, more hits than MAX_LIMIT, a line over MAX_LINE_CHARS and ripgrep output over RG_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES are all returned in full through the ripgrep backend
A ripgrep search that passes the 30-second deadline fails with its gathered hits marked incomplete and is never reported as complete
Without complete, the limits still apply and the existing grep tests pass unchanged

tests.name: grep-omitted.test.ts: through the ripgrep backend with complete set, more hits than MAX_LIMIT, a line over MAX_LINE_CHARS and output over RG_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES are all returned in full, and a search past the 30-second deadline fails with its gathered hits
grep-omitted.test.ts: without complete the ripgrep backend still applies MAX_LIMIT, MAX_LINE_CHARS and RG_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
